text:
elaine: Heads-up: proposal to remove the "Throughput Shield" add-on from the M1 pricing launch. Engineering says routing + metering complexity will push us past the ship date. Need quick takes.

dax: Leaning towards remove. The add-on requires per-tenant egress shaping + new token accounting path. Not trivial and it blocks autoscale validation.

rachel: Sales: we have three pilots that specifically asked for guaranteed throughput. If we drop it we need a clear pilot playbook or we risk deals slipping.

elaine: What minimal promise can we make to pilots without productizing the add-on?

tom: RevOps: We can offer a "reserved-throughput pilot" as a manual ops-delivered entitlement. It'd be meter-billed at current rates and tracked via an internal tag. Ops overhead but doable short term.

nico: Legal: manual pilot is OK provided contractual language specifies this is a temporary operational service, not a recurring product feature. I recommend: "Throughput Pilot: operator-mediated service; not covered by product SLAs."

anya: Design: removing the add-on simplifies the signup UI. We can add a "Request pilot" CTA on the billing page that routes to sales. Less confusion for self-serve users.

dax: Technical caveat: if we remove it we must still implement the metering hooks (token attribution) in the billing pipeline before GA. That is lower scope but critical. Estimate: 2 dev-weeks.

elaine: Let's surface the launch acceptance criteria impact matrix. Who can list pass/fail items?

tom: Quick list: ["Billing attribution: per-tenant throughput tags implemented","Autoscale validation: no regressions at 95th pc","Docs: pilot offer + ops runbook","Sales collateral + pilot template clause","Telemetry: per-tenant qps + latency metrics"]

rachel: Add: "Outbound customer comms with transition options" — I'll draft and own.

dax: Engineering acceptance item: "no new path for in-flight routing changes; feature-flag removed; smoke tests for 20k qps pass."

release-bot: Release manager: cut window is 2026-09-01. Blocking PRs: 5 open (2 critical).

elaine: Decision: remove Throughput Shield from M1. Offer operator-mediated pilot with defined contract language and a "request pilot" flow in the billing UI. Reintroduce as part of M2 with clear dev estimate. Action items:
- dax: update PRs to strip Shield feature flags and add billing hooks note (due EOD)
- tom: draft ops runbook + pilot billing tag spec (due Thu)
- rachel: customer comms + pilot offer deck + reach out to 3 pilots (due Fri)
- anya: add "Request pilot" CTA and hide Shield in UI (due Thu)
- nico: draft pilot clause & review comms (due Thu)

elaine: I'll update the roadmap and add a Milestone: "Throughput Shield M2 re-eval" with estimates.

dax: ack. I'll create a follow-up ticket: `shield-reintroduce-m2` and link to perf plan.

rachel: ack. I'll message the pilot POCs about the operator option.

nico: Posting draft clause into #legal for review.

release-bot: Note created: PROD-12567 (remove-throughput-shield).

elaine: Pinning this to the release checklist. If ops can't support the pilot path, escalate here immediately. Thanks all :rocket:
